questions.markdown:
Solve the boundary value problem by finite difference method

$$
y'' + x y = 1,\quad y(0)=0\text{ and }y'(1)=1,\quad h=\frac{1}{2}.
$$

Solve with $h=0.5$:

$$
\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}=-4,\quad |x|<1,\ |y|<1,\quad u(x,\pm 1)=x^2
$$

and

$$
u(\pm 1,y)=y^2.
$$

Solve by Crank Nicolson's method:

$$
\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}=\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2},\quad 0<x<1,\ t>0,\ u(x,0)=100(x-x^2),\ u(0,t)=0,
$$

$$
u(1,t)=0.\ \text{Compute }u\text{ for one-time step with }h=0.25.
$$

At an art exhibition, there are 12 paintings of which 10 are original. A visitor selects a painting at random and before he decides to buy, he asks the opinion of an expert about the authenticity of the painting. The expert is right in 9 out of 10 cases on average. Given that the expert decides that the painting is authentic, what is the probability that this is really the case?

Each of two people $P_1$ and $P_2$ roll a pair of dice alternatively on the understanding that the first one to get sum $7$ wins the game. If $P_1$ starts the game, what is the probability that he wins?

Fit a curve of the form $y=ae^{bx}$ by the method of least squares for the following data:

| X | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Y | 133 | 55 | 23 | 7 | 2 | 2 |

The joint probability density function of $X$ and $Y$ is

$$
f(x,y)=\begin{cases}x^2+\frac{xy}{3}, & 0\le x\le 1,\ 0\le y\le 2,\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

(a) Find the $P(Y<X)$. (b) Determine $P(X<\frac{1}{2}\mid Y<\frac{1}{2})$. (c) Compute $E(X).$

questions.markdown: Suppose $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ are pairwise independent random variables with standard deviation 5, 12 and 9, respectively. Determine the correlation coefficient between $X+Y$ and $Y+Z$.

The life time in years of an electronic device is a random variable having probability density function given by

$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}x e^{-x}, & x>0,\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

If the cost of manufacturing one such item is 2 thousand rupees and the manufacturer sells the item for 5 thousand rupees with an assurance of total refund if $x<1$, then what is the manufacturer expected profit per item.

The weekly wages of 1000 workers are normally distributed around a mean of 500 dollars with a standard deviation of 50 dollars. Estimate the number of workers whose weekly wages will be

i) Between 400 dollars and 600 dollars

ii) Less than 400 dollars

iii) More than 600 dollars

Let $X$ be a random variable with the following pdf:

$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}\lambda e^{-\lambda(x-a)}, & x>a,\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

Find the moment generating function of $X$. Hence find mean $E(X)$ and variance $V(X)$.

Let $X$ be a continuous random variable with the following pdf:

$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}2x, & 0<x<1\\0, & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

Find the pdf of $Y=X^3$.

Solve the following difference equation,

$$
y_{n+3}-5y_{n+2}+3y_{n+1}+9y_n=2^n+3^n.
$$
Find the Z-transform of: i) $\cos^2\left(\frac{n\pi}{4}\right)$ ii) $\sin\left(\frac{n\pi}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$ iii) $\frac{1}{(n+2)!}$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be two independent random variables having pdf,

$$
f(x)=e^{-x},\ 0<x<\infty\ \text{and}\ g(y)=2e^{-2y},\ 0<y<\infty,\ \text{respectively. Find the pdf of }Z=X+Y.
$$
